title.narrative: Support to the EuroMAB Network: Local to Global Action in Biosphere Reserves in Europe and North America

description.narrative: EuroMAB network is a very active, dynamic as well as the oldest and biggest regional networks. It meets every two years. Since the exit strategy, 100 % of its sites are meeting the criteria. The EuroMAB network will mobilize its experts, active working groups and conduct support missions and exchanges of practices and methodologies for improving the quality of the sites, establishing new sites and implementing the Hangzhou Strategic Action Plan.It will also look at increased cooperation with existing geoparks in its region and conduct when possible joint evaluation missions and technical workshops.
